text: Endorsements — Tommy John for NY Assembly
New York Labor Supports Assemblyman Schiavoni
local news supports tommy john schiavoni
Endorsed by Newspapers Across the East End

"Protecting the environment is a critical component of the portfolio of the East End representative and Schiavoni best follows in the tradition of Fred Thiele, who represented the District for more than three decades.

"The Democratic incumbent has been up to the task in his first term. He's sponsored legislation that matter to his constituents bolstering alpha-gal reporting, benefiting the fishing community and making sure the Suffolk County hotel/motel revenue reaches the full length of the island...
He most certainly deserves a second term."

"Mr. Schiavoni's first term record includes support for septic-system assistance and State infrastructure funding. He also co-sponsored legislation increasing the income tax credit for eligible volunteer firefighters and ambulance workers...
The editorial board has selected Tommy John Schiavoni for a second term.
Coalition building and strong relationships across all levels of government

"In just one term, Tommy John Schiavoni has established himself as an effective leader for the East End in Albany. Not only has he passed important legislation, but he has gotten results on critical projects essential to our future quality of life. Most notably has been his success in gaining the support of the LIRR to make critical infrastructure improvements to the Montauk Line that will expand public transit options like the South Fork Commuter connection. One good term deserves another. I enthusiastically endorse Tommy John for another term in the state Assembly.”

“Tommy John Schiavoni has proven that he has the unique experience needed to be a successful advocate for the East End. He has been serving Long Island for decades – as a public educator, in local government, and now as an Assemblyman who delivers. He knows how to work with all levels of government to bring results to New York’s 1st Assembly District, and I am proud to endorse his campaign for reelection.”

“Tommy John understands the importance of service to the community, he has shown up and done the work his entire adult life. In Albany, he has brought the same common sense, integrity, and commitment to fiscal responsibility that has guided him throughout his experience in government. He has shown to be the strongest voice for Eastern Long Island, and I’m proud to support his re-election campaign.”

“Tommy John Schiavoni is continuing his outstanding record of public service as the Assemblyman representing the East End in Albany. His experience has taught him to listen to his constituents closely and fight for what matters most to them. I know he will continue to advocate for us in another term as the New York State Assemblyman for the First District.”

“I have had the pleasure of working with Tommy John Schiavoni on several critical projects facing the South Fork. He is a committed, steadfast coalition builder who knows how to tackle the most pressing issues, especially on the environment. I know that I can always call on Tommy John as a partner in government, and I look forward to working together with him on the many issues that face our region.”

“As a County Legislator, I know how important it is to have a partner in Albany who knows the East End better than most. Tommy John understands the East End because he has spent his entire life here, proving himself to be a hard working public servant and listening to the people who call this place home. Tommy John Schiavoni knows our region, he shows up, and he gets things done.”
Paid for by Tommy John for NY Assembly
